title: Hierarchical Hybrid-Coordinate Flow Matching for Accurate and Physically Plausible Apo-to-Holo Protein Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting holo-like protein conformations from apo structures is essential in structure-based drug design. Most existing apo-to-holo models operate in Cartesian space and achieve strong global accuracy. However, high global accuracy does not ensure physically valid local backbone geometry. Internal-coordinate models offer local control and validity, but regressive generation can amplify angular errors, known as the lever-arm effect. We introduce CrypticFlow, a hierarchical flow-matching model that combines these two complementary representations. An ESM-3-conditioned E(3)-equivariant graph network first generates sparse C$\alpha$ anchors in Cartesian space. A conditional midpoint Transformer then recursively fills the gaps in local internal coordinates. During recursive generation, the decoder constrains the distance between each midpoint and any sequence-adjacent parent anchor to the corresponding apo C$\alpha$-C$\alpha$ distance. On t

translated_title: 用于准确且物理合理的Apo-to-Holo蛋白质生成的分层混合坐标流匹配
translated_abstract: 从非结合态（apo）结构预测类结合态（holo）蛋白构象在基于结构的药物设计中至关重要。大多数现有的apo-to-holo模型在笛卡尔空间中运行，并可实现较强的全局精度。然而，高的全局精度并不能保证物理上合理的局部主链几何结构。内坐标模型提供了局部控制和有效性，但递归式生成可能放大角度误差，即所谓的杠杆臂效应。我们提出CrypticFlow，一种结合这两种互补表示的分层流匹配模型。一个以ESM-3为条件的E(3)等变图网络首先在笛卡尔空间中生成稀疏的Cα锚点，然后条件中点Transformer在局部内坐标中递归地填补空隙。在递归生成过程中，解码器将每个中点与序列相邻父锚点之间的距离约束为对应的apo Cα-Cα距离。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CrypticFlow提出了一种分层混合坐标流匹配方法，先在笛卡尔空间生成稀疏Cα锚点，再以内坐标递归填补中点并施加距离约束，从而同时实现高全局精度与物理合理的局部几何，解决apo-to-holo蛋白构象预测问题。
en_tdlr: CrypticFlow introduces a hierarchical hybrid-coordinate flow-matching approach that generates sparse Cα anchors in Cartesian space and recursively fills gaps in internal coordinates with distance constraints, achieving both high global accuracy and physically plausible local geometry for apo-to-holo protein conformation prediction.
